sentences.text: The present appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act preferred by the insurer seeks to assail the award dated 09.05.2022 passed by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal.

2. The only ground urged by the appellant is that the learned Tribunal erred in relying on the belatedly filed income tax returns of the deceased for the year 2015-2016, which showed a radical jump in her annual income from Rs.31,881/- to Rs.4,42,022/- without appreciating the fact that the returns having been filed after the death of the deceased, some independent evidence in this regard ought to have been led.
3. The TCR, which alone can show the evidence led before the learned Tribunal has, however, not been requisitioned till date.
Both sides, therefore, pray that the TCR be requisitioned.

4. Let the TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.
5.

The Registry is directed to allocate a separate number to the application.
7.
Learned counsel for the appellant accepts notice.

8. Taking into account that the appellant has assailed the quantum of compensation granted under the award, no reply to the application is called for and same is allowed by directing the Tribunal to forthwith release 70% of the awarded amount in favour of the respondent nos.1 to 3 as per the scheme of disbursal contained in the impugned award.
